desc: Formalize the BFS-layer generating function and transition factor.
Precompute binomial coefficients, reachable DP states, and transitions grouped by used vertex count with parity pruning.
Implement the per-evaluation-point scalar DP using flattened state IDs and WA[p][a] factors; set A(0)=0 for N>1.
Implement Newton forward interpolation modulo P to recover standard coefficients and output answers for M=N-1..E.
Validate against the samples and N=2; optimize modulo operations, skip x=0, and consider a tighter degree bound if needed.
If evaluation DP is too slow, implement an alternative sparse (1+x)^K basis DP or hybrid vectorized evaluation.
